name: Isotropic Residuum Propagation
definition: A technique to reduce propagation costs by switching to cheaper isotropic propagation once the radiance anisotropy falls below a threshold, merging grids into a single global grid.
summary: Isotropic Residuum Propagation accelerates volume rendering by switching from anisotropic to isotropic propagation once radiance anisotropy drops, merging directional grids into one to reduce cost while maintaining visual accuracy.
